subject: Marketing
examFormat: Two papers taken at one sitting. Paper 1 has forty multiple-choice objective questions covering the entire syllabus, all to be answered in 50 minutes for 40 marks. Paper 2 is a 2-hour paper of six essay questions of which candidates answer any four, for 80 marks.

topics.name: Introduction to Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning of marketing
Explain the basic terms in marketing: needs, wants, demands, product, exchange, transactions and markets
Outline a brief history of marketing in Nigeria
State the functions of marketing

topics.name: Marketing Concepts
objectives: Explain the meaning of marketing concepts
Explain the various marketing concepts: production, product, selling, marketing and societal marketing

topics.name: Marketing Mix and Marketing Environment
objectives: Explain the meaning of the marketing mix
Identify its elements (the 4 Ps)
Explain the marketing environment
Explain the factors affecting the marketing environment: political, cultural, religious, economic, technological and social

topics.name: Products
objectives: Explain the meaning of a product
Classify products: industrial goods, consumer goods, services, primary and secondary products, and mineral products (oil and non-oil)
Distinguish between classes of products
Explain product design (emphasis on practical)

topics.name: Markets
objectives: Explain the meaning of a market
Classify markets: consumer and organization (industrial, reseller and government)

topics.name: Consumer and Organizational Behaviour
objectives: Explain the meaning of consumer and organizational behaviour
Identify the influencing factors
Describe the decision process in logical order

topics.name: Marketing Planning and Research
objectives: Explain the meaning, process and importance of marketing planning
Identify the elements of marketing planning
State the information required for marketing planning
State the reasons for marketing planning and research
Utilize feedback

topics.name: Pricing
objectives: Explain the meaning of pricing
Explain the pricing strategies: haggling, cost-plus, demand and competition
Apply pricing strategies (emphasis on practical)
Identify price determinants

topics.name: Advertising
objectives: Define advertising
State the functions of advertising
Explain advertising media: meaning, types, advantages and disadvantages
Produce sample adverts (emphasis on practical)

topics.name: Sales Promotion
objectives: Explain the meaning and functions of sales promotion
Identify the forms: price-off, coupons, salesmen competition, loyalty schemes, premium offers, trade-in-allowance, sampling, training schemes and merchandising incentives

topics.name: Merchandising
objectives: Explain the meaning of merchandising
Identify its elements: packaging, branding and labeling
Identify the influencing factors
State the functions of merchandising

topics.name: Distribution
objectives: Define distribution
Define and identify the types of channels of distribution
State the factors influencing the choice of distribution channels
State the functions of channel members

topics.name: Transportation
objectives: Explain the meaning, modes, choice and importance of transportation
Identify the documents used in transportation
State the factors affecting the choice of transportation

topics.name: Warehousing
objectives: Explain the meaning, types and functions of warehousing
Describe the activities in the warehouse

topics.name: Market Unions and Facilitators
objectives: Explain the meaning and types of market unions
State the roles of market unions in local markets
Explain the meaning, types and roles of market facilitators

topics.name: International Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning, importance/reasons and methods of engaging in international marketing
Identify the influencing factors
State the guiding rules and regulations

topics.name: ICT in Marketing
objectives: Explain e-marketing (electronic marketing): meaning, importance, uses, ethics and abuses

topics.name: Entrepreneurship in Marketing
objectives: Explain the meaning of entrepreneurship and entrepreneur
Identify sources of funds
State the factors affecting the location of a market outlet
Describe the management of market outlets: purchase and supply of goods and services
Apply selling and bargaining skills
